semantics: Additive provisioning packet separate from frozen snapshot/begin/append/preview/commit/status/abort. No route/capability activation is included.
Require exact current runtime, target_id and captured registry revision. target_id is an opaque current runtime association, never a name, slot, URL, token hash or a persistent identity.

expected_binding_revision and response binding_revision are canonical decimal safe integers encoded as strings, maximum9007199254740991. Reject noncanonical, negative, out-of-range or bool values. UUIDs are exact lowercase UUIDv4, profile/source distinct.

Wire callers supply ONLY public scope UUIDs and target_id. Private selectors, owners, credentials, server addresses and grant handles are forbidden. Current private target must already be a verified Plex PMS; unsupported/manual/unverified targets refuse.
create omits scope/prior_scope; host allocates a fresh random profile/source UUID pair and binds both to the selected verified current target in one physical registry document.
import requires scope and may add missing matching public profile/source rows, then pairs them explicitly; existing identities/provider/parent remain unchanged. Imported UUIDs alone confer no grant.

pair requires both existing matching public rows. Identical current pair is an idempotent changed:false response with captured revision unchanged. Different existing private target bindings refuse; pair/import do not silently rebind.

replace-current requires desired scope and exact prior_scope with ALL FOUR UUIDs distinct. Same scope uses pair; same or partially overlapping replacement identities reject. Prior profile/source provider and parent relationship must match and both private bindings must match the captured current verified target.

Refuse any additional bound child source on the prior profile. Also refuse a conflicting bound child on the desired profile; do not disturb unrelated grants. Unbound public child rows may remain inert.

Retain prior public rows and withdraw ONLY their two private binding fields, then attach/create desired matching public IDs to that same authorized current target in ONE registry CAS. Public identity rows are never deleted/reused. No favorites, history, media, credentials or other store is written.

Before CAS compare the exact full actual registry beforeRaw with both normal and persisted reads. Repeat captured target and both current-owner checks; prior private proof is required pre-CAS. After CAS require exact whole persisted afterRaw readback plus current target/new-pair checks. Prior rows are intentionally unbound after replacement.

Single-document optimistic CAS/readback is not a cross-tab, fsync or cross-store atomicity claim. Host must provide the actual physical registry read/CAS/persistedRead ports. No RAM-only verified persistent response.

Emit the exact success response ONLY after actual persisted readback/current proof. changed:false means binding_revision equals expected_binding_revision; changed:true requires a different verified revision. paired:true/outcome:verified/persistence:persistent are absent on errors.

Unknown CAS, failed readback or postwrite context change returns a minimal sanitized error, never a verified claim. Missing response/unknown is not proof of no write. Do not blindly replay; reconcile a fresh bindingcatalog/current registry revision and explicit requested scope before any new request.
All errors use exactly {version,runtime,op,error:string}. outcome_unknown is additive for provision only and does not expand the frozen seven-operation error set.

private_factory_mapping.private_target_contract: provisionTarget resolves one current verified PMS/parent/source context. First scope deliberately requires shared parent/source owner, AND current(entry,binding) proof for both; owner-string equality alone is not authority.

limitations: No implemented remote DTO validator/router or runtime registration is claimed by this document.
Synthetic examples are not live grants or public identity allocation results.
Only current verified Plex foundation; no inactive/all-provider or cross-store provisioning guarantee.
